title: [yang-models] sonic-system-aaa.yang missing key in aaa authentication
author: wen587
body:

#### Description
`apply-patch` to config aaa authentication failed due to some key in sonic-system-aaa.yang being unsupported.
Whereas `sudo config aaa authentication` to config has no problem.
```
admin@vlab-01:~$ sudo config aaa authentication -h
Usage: config aaa authentication [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  User authentication

Options:
  -h, -?, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  debug        AAA debug [enable | disable | default]
  failthrough  Allow AAA fail-through [enable | disable | default]
  fallback     Allow AAA fallback [enable | disable | default]
  login        Switch login authentication [ {radius, tacacs+, local} |...
  trace        AAA packet trace [enable | disable | default]
admin@vlab-01:~$ sudo config aaa authentication debug enable
admin@vlab-01:~$ sudo config aaa authentication failthrough enable
admin@vlab-01:~$ sudo config aaa authentication fallback enable
admin@vlab-01:~$ sudo config aaa authentication trace enable
admin@vlab-01:~$ show aaa
AAA authentication login local (default)
AAA authentication failthrough True
AAA authentication debug True
AAA authentication fallback True
AAA authentication trace True
AAA authorization login local (default)
AAA accounting login disable (default)

```
<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Add AAA authentication config by `apply-patch`
2. config action fails
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
```
admin@vlab-01:~/tacacs$ sudo config apply-patch -i /FEATURE -i /QUEUE -i /SCHEDULER t1.json
Patch Applier: Patch application starting.
Patch Applier: Patch: [{"op": "add", "path": "/AAA", "value": {"authentication": {"debug": "True", "failthrough": "True", "fallback": "True", "login": "local,tacacs+", "trace": "True"}}}]
...
sonic_yang(3):All Keys are not parsed in AAA
dict_keys(['authentication'])
sonic_yang(3):exceptionList:["'fallback'"]
sonic_yang(3):Data Loading Failed:All Keys are not parsed in AAA
dict_keys(['authentication'])
Failed to apply patch
Usage: config apply-patch [OPTIONS] PATCH_FILE_PATH
Try "config apply-patch -h" for help.

Error: Given patch is not valid because it will result in an invalid config
```
```
dict_keys(['authentication'])
sonic_yang(3):exceptionList:["'trace'"]
sonic_yang(3):Data Loading Failed:All Keys are not parsed in AAA
```
```
libyang[0]: Invalid value "True" in "failthrough" element. (path: /sonic-system-aaa:sonic-system-aaa/AAA/AAA_LIST[type='authentication']/failthrough)
sonic_yang(3):Data Loading Failed:Invalid value "True" in "failthrough" element.
Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models:
BGP_PEER_RANGE, CONSOLE_SWITCH, DEVICE_NEIGHBOR_METADATA, DHCP_SERVER, KDUMP, RESTAPI, SNMP, SNMP_COMMUNITY, TELEMETRY,
libyang[0]: Invalid value "True" in "debug" element. (path: /sonic-system-aaa:sonic-system-aaa/AAA/AAA_LIST[type='authentication']/debug)
sonic_yang(3):Data Loading Failed:Invalid value "True" in "debug" element.
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
Expected `apply-patch` action succeed.

AAA yang model is not up to date.

#### How I did it
Add fallback and trace field, and replace boolean_type

#### How to verify it
Run UT for sonic_yang_models.
Follow the steps from #9710
